name: sshfs
description: Discover configured OpenSSH hosts, execute remote commands, and explicitly mount remote files.

interface.shortDescription: Explicitly mount SSH remote files before accessing them.
interface.longDescription: This plugin exposes host_list to discover explicit aliases from the user's ~/.ssh/config and included files, host_exec to run non-interactive process or service commands in a host's default shell, and host_mount when sshfs is available to mount <host>:/ under ~/.cache/sshfs-addon/<host>/ for local file tools. host_exec does not support sudo or password prompts. Healthy mounts are reused and conflicting filesystems are never unmounted.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use host_list to discover configured SSH aliases. For every SSH remote file read, write, edit, search, listing, or inspection request, call host_mount first and then use local file tools under its returned paths. Use host_exec for remote process or service commands; it is non-interactive and does not support sudo or password prompts. Keep grep and find scoped to narrow paths; never recursively scan a mounted root.
